summary.zh: 在一个片元着色器里完成整个 3D 场景：球体追踪、SDF 图元、平滑并集、梯度法线、软阴影与环境光遮蔽。
summary.en: A whole 3D scene in one fragment shader: sphere tracing, SDF primitives, smooth union, gradient normals, soft shadows and ambient occlusion.

zh: 把 smooth union k 调到 0.001，再调到 0.8，观察融合程度。
在 map 里加一个 sdSphere，并用 max(a, -b) 从圆环上挖一块。
用 mod(p.xz, 3.0) - 1.5 重复空间，变出无限多个物体。
en: Set smooth union k to 0.001, then to 0.8, and compare how much the shapes melt.
Add another sdSphere to map and use max(a, -b) to carve a piece out of the torus.
Repeat space with mod(p.xz, 3.0) - 1.5 to get infinitely many objects.
